rows.evidence: 5 — strong-human. Somatropin has one of the most extensive clinical evidence bases of any peptide therapeutic, supported by decades of FDA-approved use across 10+ indications. In pediatric GH deficiency, RCTs and large registry data consistently demonstrate significant improvements in height velocity and adult height. In adult GHD, placebo-controlled trials show improvements in body composition (reduced fat mass, increased lean mass), bone density, lipid profiles, and quality of life. The anti-aging and performance applications - pursued off-label by a significant market - have mixed evidence: body composition improvements are real but modest, and are accompanied by meaningful side effects including insulin resistance, fluid retention, and carpal tunnel syndrome. Long-term oncological risk from supraphysiologic IGF-1 elevation is the primary unresolved safety question.
